actions.chatWithCopilot.description: Send a message to an existing Copilot conversation or creating a new one and get a response
actions.chatWithCopilot.props.conversati: The ID of an existing conversation. If not provided, a new conversation will be created.
actions.chatWithCopilot.props.timeZone.d: User location time zone in IANA format (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London)
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.searchCopilot.description: Perform hybrid (semantic and lexical) search across OneDrive for work or school content using natural language queries
actions.searchCopilot.props.filterExpres: KQL filter expression for OneDrive data source (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sharepoint/dev/general-development/keyword-query-language-kql-syntax-reference). Example: path:"https://contoso-my.sharepoint.com/personal/user/Documents/"
actions.searchCopilot.props.query.descri: Natural language query to search for relevant files. Maximum 1,500 characters.
actions.searchCopilot.props.resourceMeta: Array of metadata field names to include in results. Example: ["title", "author"]
auth.description:
**Note:** This piece requires a **Microsoft 365 Copilot license** to access Copilot interaction data.

If you’d like to use your own custom Azure app instead of the default app, follow the [Azure app creation guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/quickstart-register-app#register-an-application),
 set the **Redirect URI** to {{redirectUrl}} and add the following **Microsoft Graph (Delegated) permissions** under **API permissions**:
 - Sites.Read.All
 - Mail.Read
 - Files.ReadWrite.All
 - People.Read.All
 - OnlineMeetingTranscript.Read.All
 - Chat.Read
 - ChannelMessage.Read.All
 - ExternalItem.Read.All
 - AiEnterpriseInteraction.Read
 - Files.Read.All
